findings.title: findMany method removed, breaking existing callers
findings.body: The public `findMany(findManyArgs)` method on InsightsBookingService was deleted and replaced by `getBaseConditions()`, which only returns a `Prisma.Sql` fragment. Any existing caller that invoked `service.findMany({ select: ... })` to query `bookingTimeStatusDenormalized` will now fail to compile (or at runtime), and callers must now hand-write `$queryRaw` SQL against the `BookingTimeStatusDenormalized` table themselves, duplicating table/column knowledge outside the service. The PR does not update or mention any call sites. Either keep a `findMany`-style query method in the service or update/migrate all consumers in this PR.

findings.title: getBaseConditions integration test asserts exact result set without ORDER BY and without isolating other rows
findings.body: The test runs `SELECT id FROM "BookingTimeStatusDenormalized" WHERE ${baseConditions}` and asserts `results` equals exactly `[{ id: userBooking.id }]`. The denormalized table is populated asynchronously from Booking rows in production-like setups; the test creates rows in `Booking` but never verifies/writes the denormalized rows, so the query may return zero rows (or stale rows from other test data matching the same user/eventType) making the assertion flaky. Also, without ORDER BY, any multi-row match has nondeterministic ordering for a strict toEqual on an array. The test should either write directly to the denormalized table or tolerate ordering (e.g., expect.arrayContaining / sorted comparison).

findings.title: Caching behavior tests removed without replacement
findings.body: The two 'Caching' describe-block tests verifying that getAuthorizationConditions and getFilterConditions return cached results on second invocation were deleted. The caching logic still exists in the service (cachedAuthConditions / cachedFilterConditions), so this regression coverage is lost; a bug that drops caching would silently cause repeated DB membership lookups per query. Re-add equivalent tests against the new Prisma.Sql return values.
